The **Kremlin** has acknowledged temporary difficulties in fuel supplies, attributing them to enemy air attacks. Ukrainian forces have targeted key roads and bridges connecting Crimea to mainland Russia, disrupting the flow of military and civilian goods.  The strikes are also impacting Russia's ability to fight, according to analysts.

recent_articles.title: Deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir: What’s going on? | Civil Rights News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Deadly protests erupted in Pakistan-administered Kashmir's Rawalakot city, resulting in the deaths of eleven people and over 70 injuries. The unrest is fueled by a ban on the Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), which advocates for the abolition of reserved seats for refugees from Indian-administered Kashmir.  The JAAC claims these seats are unconstitutional, while authorities argue they are protected under the region's constitution. **Sardar Waheed Khan**, commissioner of the Pakistan side of the Poonch district, stated that police officers and a passerby were killed after being shot by protesters. The protests have been met with restrictions on travel and internet access.  **Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari**, chairman of the Pakistan Peoples’ Party (PPP), has pledged to meet Prime Minister **Shehbaz Sharif** to discuss the situation.

recent_articles.title: 300 migrants bound for UK kidnapped and threatened with kidney removal
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The BBC** has uncovered evidence of a kidnapping and torture ring operating in Libya, targeting migrants from Iraqi Kurdistan. **Noah Aaron**, an Iraqi Kurd smuggler who was sentenced to 10 years in France for money laundering and smuggling offenses, is believed to have been involved in the operation. The group kidnapped over 300 migrants last summer, demanding a ransom of $5,000 (£3,700) from each family.  The victims were held in cramped conditions and threatened with forced organ removal if payment was not made promptly. While some hostages were released, many remain missing or have been subjected to torture, including burning their legs and forcing them to sleep standing up for months. **Anthony Dunkerley**, a UN adviser who has investigated human trafficking in Libya, notes that the lack of state control in the country allows criminal groups to exploit migrants.

recent_articles.title: VHP leaders seek strict implementation of cow protection laws in Kurnool - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **VHP** and **Bajrang Dal** leaders met with **T.G. Bharath**, Minister of Industries and Commerce, in Kurnool to request stricter enforcement of the cow slaughter ban. The delegation, led by **Thumukunta Pratap Reddy**, expressed gratitude for **Bharath's** directive to government officials to strictly enforce the laws, ensuring no cows are transported illegally and preventing cow slaughter.

recent_articles.title: Six countries sanction enablers of settler violence in occupied West Bank | Israel-Palestine conflict News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Six countries—the UK, Australia, Canada, France, New Zealand, and Norway—imposed coordinated sanctions targeting networks involved in financing, enabling, and carrying out settler violence against Palestinians in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. The move followed record illegal settlement expansion and rising violence by settlers.  The countries warned that they are prepared to take further measures if the Israeli government fails to address the situation on the ground. Israel's foreign ministry denounced the sanctions as politically motivated attempts to impose a stance on Jewish settlements in the West Bank, while Amnesty International called for stronger action against those who support and sponsor settler violence.

recent_articles.title: ‘Not just about giving money’: Lokesh pledges long-term support for steel blast families - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **IT Minister Nara Lokesh** and **Union Minister for Steel H. D. Kumaraswamy** visited the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant (VSP) following a recent blast, where they announced immediate financial compensation of ₹25 lakh to families of the victims.  The government is committed to securing the future of the affected families, including providing education and welfare support for their children. **Mr. Lokesh** also highlighted the NDA government's swift response to the incident, emphasizing continuous monitoring by senior ministers and the announcement of permanent employment for one member from each affected family. Workers expressed concern about the plant's future, particularly regarding potential privatization, while **Mr. Lokesh** assured them that the government is committed to safeguarding VSP.
